data.name: Druid's Crown
data.detailed_description:
Druid's Crown is a whimsical yet meaningful 4-player couch co-op 3D platformer set in a richly imagined world inspired by ancient Irish folklore. Designed by an indie team of Irish developers, this is a game about remembrance, ritual, and renewal, not through battle, but through collaboration, exploration, and care.

Long ago, the Heartroot Tree held the memory of the valley. Its roots reached into the past. Its canopy shimmered with the melodies of life. But time frayed those threads — its keepers lost, its memory fading.

Now, four souls, not warriors, but shepherds, hear its final breath. Drawn by a call not of words but of longing, they return to restore what was lost.

Their mission is simple yet profound: climb, retrieve, and replant. Scale the withered limbs of the Heartroot. Discover the Seeds of Life, glowing with the essence of forgotten songs. Carry them to the sacred altars. Watch the tree grow and change with each cycle.

Key Features

  • Local 4-Player Co-Op: Gather your friends on the couch and experience a story best shared.

  • Climb Together, Grow Together: Work as a team to scale the evolving structure of the Heartroot Tree. Coordinate movements, assist one another, and carry seeds across handcrafted levels full of mystical terrain.

  • Evolving World: Each seed planted alters the tree, unlocking new branches to climb, new songs to hear, and new memories to unearth. The Heartroot Tree grows not just upwards, but outward, in complexity and wonder.

  • Irish Aesthetic & Lore: From its moss-covered stones to the faint echo of an ancient bodhrán drum, the world of The Heartroot Tree is infused with Celtic inspiration, from Druidic symbols to ghostly myths reborn in green light.

  • No Combat, Only Care: This is not a world to conquer, but to heal. There are no enemies to slay, only challenges to overcome, together.
